name: Paetongtarn Shinawatra
quote: My intention was to help stabilise the situation and I never expected the conversation to be leaked.

name: Anutin Charnvirakul
quote: I followed the law. I have the Joint Statement, signed by the leaders of both countries.

name: Natthaphon Narkphanit
role: Defence Minister / Director, Ad Hoc Centre for the Border Situation
quote: We will keep our forces deployed along the border for at least one year to safeguard national sovereignty.

name: 2nd Army Region Commander
role: Royal Thai Army, border sector command
quote: No retreat from our 11 positions along the border.

name: Hun Manet
quote: Our position is to always stick to peaceful resolutions. We don't believe that using war to stop a war is sustainable or practical.

name: Hun Sen
role: President of the Cambodian Senate, former Prime Minister
quote: If the Thai side continues to avoid this approach, it suggests that there is something hidden behind it.

name: Tea Seiha
role: Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of National Defence, Cambodia
quote: Today's ceasefire also paves the way for the displaced people who are living in the border areas to be able to return to their homes, work in the fields, and even allow their children to return to schools.

name: Cambodia Ministry of Foreign Affairs
quote: No legal rights can arise from such unlawful acts, and the visit cannot legitimize Thailand's illegal occupation. Borderlines must not be changed by force.

name: Anwar Ibrahim
role: Prime Minister of Malaysia, ASEAN Chair 2025
quote: This is a vital first step towards de-escalation and the restoration of peace and security.

name: ASEAN Observer Team (Philippines-led)
quote: The Philippines renews its impartiality pledge as head of the ASEAN Observer Team overseeing the Cambodia-Thailand ceasefire.

name: UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs
role: UN humanitarian coordination, Thailand-Cambodia border response
quote: The situation remains fragile, with ongoing humanitarian needs driven by displacement, disrupted services, and damage to homes, schools, health facilities and critical infrastructure.

name: Donald Trump
quote: I stopped a war just today.

name: Xi Jinping
quote: China stands ready to play a constructive role in resolving the border dispute, which is in both sides' long-term interests.

name: International Crisis Group
quote: The border dispute with Cambodia has sparked significant political disarray inside Thailand, well beyond the immediate military confrontation.

name: World Bank Cambodia Economic Update
quote: Cambodia enters this period with relatively strong macroeconomic buffers, with international reserves remaining adequate at the equivalent of 7.5 months of imports, inflation contained at an average of 2.7 percent, and public debt around 26 percent of GDP.
